spec.rawSql:
SELECT c.name, c.lat, c.lon, m.value AS poverty_rate
FROM counties c
JOIN county_metrics m ON m.fips = c.fips
WHERE m.metric = 'poverty_rate' AND m.year = 2022

SELECT c.name, c.lat, c.lon, m.value AS unemployment_rate
FROM counties c
JOIN county_metrics m ON m.fips = c.fips
WHERE m.metric = 'unemployment_rate' AND m.year = 2022

SELECT c.name, c.lat, c.lon, m.value AS eviction_filing_rate
FROM counties c
JOIN county_metrics m ON m.fips = c.fips
WHERE m.metric = 'eviction_filing_rate' AND m.year = 2017

spec.title: Food Desert Population Share by County (US, 2019)

spec.rawSql:
SELECT c.name, c.lat, c.lon, m.value AS food_desert_population_share
FROM counties c
JOIN county_metrics m ON m.fips = c.fips
WHERE m.metric = 'food_desert_population_share' AND m.year = 2019

SELECT c.name, c.lat, c.lon, m.value AS co2_emissions_total_kt FROM counties c 
JOIN county_metrics m ON m.fips = c.fips WHERE m.metric = 'co2_emissions_total_kt' AND m.year = 2022
